title: 第9章 小小磨炼不危险第10章 得意忘形李某某
content_zh:
;;
湖岸不远处，秦婀娜，张邋遢都看到了这一幕，互视一眼，谁都没有说什么。
李家二公子，当真惊人。
如此年纪，如此修为，简直可怕。
湖边，李子夜默默捡起了地上的剑，一向不肯吃亏的性子，此刻，也没有半句顶撞。
“庆之。”
远处，李幼薇看到李庆之走来，轻声道，“小弟已经很努力了，给他一点时间。”
“长姐，你和义父能护他几时？”
李庆之神色淡漠道，“他若一直如此废材，李府，早晚败在他手中。”
“李府有今日，小弟占了很大功劳，如今，他也在努力守护这个家，庆之，希望你能多给他一点耐心和时间。”李幼薇轻叹道。
“他的确带给了李府辉煌，但是，他没有能力去守，便是最大的错。”李庆之双目余光注视着湖岸边的少年，神色冷漠道。
湖边，李子夜捡起剑，交还给了秦婀娜。
“仙子，能不能请半日假，今天欠下的次数，我回来后会补齐。”李子夜说道。
“去吧。”
秦婀娜并没有多问，接过青霜古剑，点头应道。
“多谢仙子。”
李子夜谢了一句，迈步朝着远处走去。
“二哥。”
两人身前，李子夜快步走来，纵然方才刚被教训一顿，依旧嬉皮笑脸地问候道，“你回来了。”
李庆之注视着眼前少年，淡淡道，“剑练完了？”

“还没有，此前答应三皇子，这两日要给他一个答复。”李子夜回答道。
“你长姐要去都城，此事，你知道吗？”李庆之问道。
“知道。”李子夜点头道。
“都城水深，此事，本该是你这个嫡子的责任，却是因为你的不作为，所以才只能让你长姐去，明白吗？”李庆之冷声道。
“二哥教训的是。”李子夜很是虚心地接受批评，应道。
“你长姐去都城，我也会暗中跟去，渝州城这边就交给你了。”李庆之淡淡道。
“二哥放心。”
李子夜脑袋点的跟鼓槌一般，看上去要多听话，便有多听话，任谁也想不到，这是李家那无法无天的小公子。
“去吧，那三皇子心机深沉，小心应付。”李庆之神色稍稍缓和了一些，叮嘱道。
“多谢二哥关心，我会小心的。”
难得被兄长关心一句，李子夜开心地应了一声，旋即屁颠屁颠离开。
“你啊，对小弟太苛刻了。”
看到前者离开，李幼薇无奈道，“其实，他很尊重你这个兄长，每次你回来，他都会高兴很久。”
“他是李府唯一的嫡子，就应该承担比别人更重的责任，这是命。”
李庆之平静道，“对了，为他寻找佩剑一事，我会留意，据说东海和南疆现世了几柄不错的古剑，若是有时间，我会亲自走一趟。”
“你啊，总是嘴硬心软。”李幼薇轻声道。
悦来客栈，二楼客房。

Not far from the lake shore, Qin Wugna and Zhang Sugao both saw this scene and looked at each other without saying anything.
The second young master of the Li family is truly astonishing.
At such an age and with such a level of cultivation, it is simply terrifying.
By the lake, Li Ziye silently picked up the sword on the ground. He always refused to suffer losses, but at this moment, he didn't say a word to contradict him.
"Celebrate it."
In the distance, Li Youwei saw Li Qingzhi approaching and said softly, "My little brother has already worked very hard, give him some time."
"Eldest sister, how long can you and your adoptive father protect him?"
Li Qingzhi said with an indifferent expression, "If he continues to be such a waste, Li Mansion will be defeated by him sooner or later."
"My younger brother takes a lot of credit for the success of the Li family today. Now, he is also working hard to protect this family. Qingzhi, I hope you can give him a little more patience and time." Li Youwei sighed softly.
"He did bring glory to the Li Mansion, but it was his biggest fault that he was unable to defend it." Li Qingzhi looked at the young man on the lake shore with his peripheral eyes and said with an indifferent expression.
By the lake, Li Ziye picked up the sword and handed it back to Qin Grace.
"Fairy, can you take half a day off? I will make up for the debt I owe today when I come back." Li Ziye said.
"Go ahead."
Qin Wanna didn't ask any more questions. She took the Qingshuang Ancient Sword and nodded in response.
"Thank you fairy."
Li Ziye thanked him and walked away.
"Second brother."
In front of the two of them, Li Ziye walked quickly. Even though he had just been taught a lesson, he still greeted him with a playful smile, "You're back."
Li Qingzhi looked at the young man in front of him and said calmly, "Have you finished your sword practice?"
"Not yet. I promised the third prince that I would give him an answer in the next two days." Li Ziye replied.
"Your eldest sister is going to the capital. Do you know about this?" Li Qingzhi asked.
"I know." Li Ziye nodded.
"The water in the capital is deep. This matter should have been the responsibility of you, the legitimate son, but it was because of your inaction that I had to let your eldest sister go. Do you understand?" Li Qingzhi said coldly.
"Second brother taught me a lesson." Li Ziye accepted the criticism humbly and responded.
"When your eldest sister goes to the capital, I will follow you secretly. I will leave Yuzhou City to you." Li Qingzhi said calmly.
"Second brother, don't worry."
Li Ziye's head was nodding like a drumstick, and he seemed to be as obedient as he was. No one could have imagined that this was the lawless young master of the Li family.
"Go ahead, that third prince is very scheming, so handle him with caution." Li Qingzhi's expression softened slightly and he warned.
"Thank you for your concern, second brother, I will be careful."
It was rare to receive a word of concern from his brother, so Li Ziye responded happily and left immediately.
"You are too harsh on my little brother."
Seeing the former leave, Li Youwei said helplessly, "Actually, he respects you as an elder brother. Every time you come back, he will be happy for a long time."
"He is the only legitimate son of the Li family, so he should bear heavier responsibilities than others. This is his fate."
Li Qingzhi said calmly, "By the way, I will pay attention to finding a sword for him. It is said that there are several good ancient swords in the East China Sea and Southern Xinjiang. If I have time, I will go there myself."
"You are always hard-spoken and soft-hearted." Li Youwei said softly.
Yuelai Inn, guest room on the second floor.
